description: Remove a supplier contact's vendor portal access: an active login can no longer sign in, and a pending invitation's emailed link stops working. Name the supplier (id or exact name) and the user by the id from list_vendor_portal_users or by email. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and an Admin user.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

supplier.description: The supplier's id (GUID) or exact name.

user.description: The portal user: the id from list_vendor_portal_users, or their email.

name: revoke_vendor_portal_access
title: Revoke Vendor Portal Access
